scope_note: Second-pass model review retains only three presentation-preserving unit conversions of Google-reported Douglas County water consumption for 2022-2024. Each estimate converts a displayed million-gallon location value to gallons and carries the source's 0.1-million-gallon rounding precision; no withdrawal, discharge, meter, campus-building, or cost allocation is introduced. Direct searches of operator, water-authority, Georgia EPD, EPA, assessor, permit, utility, workforce, supplier, fiscal, and county-outcome sources did not support any other eligible model. No transferred multiplier, payroll estimate, supplier-retention assumption, energy proxy, fiscal result, public-cost threshold, investment allocation, or causal county outcome is modeled.

sources.title: Economic impact of Google data centers in Georgia
sources.notes: The Douglas County sustainability page reports water consumption of 305.2 million gallons in 2022 and 345.6 million gallons in 2023. The values are location-level, rounded, and not allocated to an individual building or meter.

sources.title: Google 2025 Environmental Report
sources.notes: The assured location table reports Douglas County 2024 water consumption of 366.9 million gallons, calculated as 444.1 million gallons withdrawal minus 77.2 million gallons discharge. Displayed values are rounded; no building allocation, bill, tariff, or cost is published.
